title: 第5章 纪夫人亲一下第6章 别着急很快就知道我是谁
slug: 领证爽约我转嫁你哥哭什么
content_zh:
第5章纪夫人，亲一下？唐凝的话让唐老爷子难以置信，一而再确认后，笑得比刚才还爽朗。
“好，结婚了就好，什么时候带回来跟爷爷一起吃顿饭？”
唐凝乖巧答应：“好的，爷爷。”
挂了电话，卧室门被打开。
纪瑾修进入房间，长腿阔步来到她面前。
气质矜贵清雅，剑眉星目，长得真是好看极了。
唐凝呼吸一滞，仰头看他，“你回来了。”
纪瑾修嗯了声，嗓音暗哑，“新婚燕尔，回来陪你吃饭。”
唐凝忽而心头一暖，“谢谢。”
以前跟纪寒恋爱，约好吃饭，也能让她在餐厅白等几个小时。
后来才知道，他是被纪馨宁叫走。
纪馨宁打个喷嚏，纪寒都会紧张地送医院。
唐凝何时都是被他撇下的那个。
她生气，还要被纪寒嫌弃她作，计较。
唐凝收敛思绪。
把笔记本合上，随手放在飘窗上，起身对他微微一笑，“不过你不用刻意回来陪我，没关系的。”
本就是各取所需的闪婚。
“陪你理所应当。”
纪瑾修凝着她，温声，“我说过，想要的是可以一起生活，睡觉的婚姻。”
唐凝的心漾开丝丝暖意，却没有多想。

她知道纪瑾修本就成熟稳重，并非对她有什么特殊，于是点了点头，“好，我洗个手，陪你下楼吃饭。”
她走向浴室。
纪瑾修目送，看着她的背影，眸色愈浓。
……
一楼餐厅，两人面对面坐在方桌前，柔和的灯光洒在他们身上。
男俊女美，是一幅很温馨的画面。
餐桌上好几道菜，全是唐凝爱吃的。
想不到他们口味相同。
唐凝板板正正地坐着，安安静静地用餐。
忽然。
纪瑾修夹了一块香炸排骨，放入她的碗里，“你爱吃的，多吃点。”
content_en:
Chapter 5 Mrs. Ji, would you like a kiss? Tang Ning's words made Mr. Tang unbelievable. After confirming them again and again, he smiled even more heartily than before.
"Okay, just get married. When will you bring me back to have a meal with grandpa?"
Tang Ning obediently agreed: "Okay, grandpa."
After hanging up the phone, the bedroom door was opened.
Ji Jinxiu entered the room and strode up to her with long legs.
She has a noble and elegant temperament, sword-shaped eyebrows and starry eyes, and she is really beautiful.
Tang Ning's breath stopped and she looked up at him, "You're back."
Ji Jinxiu hummed, his voice hoarse, "Newlywed Yan'er, come back and have dinner with you."
Tang Ning suddenly felt warm in her heart, "Thank you."
In the past, when I was in love with Ji Han, even if I made an appointment to have dinner, she would wait in the restaurant for hours.
Later I found out that he was called away by Ji Xinning.
Whenever Ji Xinning sneezes, Ji Han will be sent to the hospital nervously.
Tang Ning was always the one left behind by him.
She was angry and wanted to be blamed and cared about by Ji Han.
Tang Ning gathered her thoughts.
He closed the notebook and placed it on the bay window. He stood up and smiled at him, "But you don't have to come back to stay with me. It's okay."
This is a flash marriage where everyone gets what they want.
"It's natural to accompany you."
Ji Jinxiu stared at her and said warmly, "I said that what I want is a marriage where we can live and sleep together."
Tang Ning's heart felt warm, but she didn't think much about it.
She knew that Ji Jinxiu was mature and steady and had nothing special to her, so she nodded, "Okay, I'll wash my hands and accompany you downstairs for dinner."
She went to the bathroom.
Ji Jinxiu watched her off and looked at her back, his eyes getting darker.
…
In the restaurant on the first floor, the two of them sat face to face at the square table, with soft light shining on them.
The handsome men and beautiful women are a very warm picture.
There were several dishes on the table, all of which were Tang Ning's favorites.
I had no idea they tasted the same.
Tang Ning sat upright and ate quietly.
suddenly.
Ji Jinxiu picked up a piece of fried pork ribs and put it into her bowl, "Eat more of what you like."
